the model says the meaning changed: EX-9 says any change to pyproject.toml sets full verification pending, but the infra digest now blanks every `version = "..."` line, so a version-only edit (or a version line in any table) no longer sets it.; filed as a question for the owner, to ask with the question tool: You asked for the full test suite to run only for a named reason, such as a change to shared test infrastructure. The requirement matches that: when pyproject.toml changes, status says a full run is pending.

The code now ignores every `version = "..."` line in pyproject.toml when it checks whether that file changed. If only those lines differ, no full run becomes pending. A comment in the code gives the reason: a plugin rebuild rewrites the version line, and that alone should not trigger a full run. This fits your wish to avoid unnecessary full runs, but the requirement makes no exception for it.

The new check is also broader than that reason. It ignores any line named `version`, in any section of the file, not just the project's own version. A real change, such as a pinned dependency or tool version written on its own `version` line, would therefore no longer make a full run pending.

What is unclear is whether you wanted this. The message logged around the time of the change is about aborting a merge and says nothing about pyproject.toml or full runs. The change looks deliberate, so I can't treat it as a plain mistake, and only you can decide whether this exception should exist.; the card is not offered until it is complete, it lacks: what option 1 ("Keep the exception, but limit it to the project's own version line, and update the requirement to say so") does and leaves undone; what option 2 ("Keep the change as it is, so any version line is ignored, and update the requirement to say so") does and leaves undone; what option 3 ("Undo the change, so any pyproject.toml edit, including a rebuild's version bump, makes a full run pending") does and leaves undone; why the recommended option is recommended (iaso stale card SR-255#3 --consequences "..." --why "...")
